SELECT t.id AS trainerId, t.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phoneNum, u.profile_image AS profileImg, t.trainer_type AS trainerType, t.approval_status AS approvalStatus, COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_id) AS memberCount FROM TRAINER t JOIN `USER` u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN PT_PACKAGE p ON t.id = p.trainer_id AND (p.expires_at IS NULL OR p.expires_at >= NOW()) WHERE t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND u.is_deleted = false
AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(t.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY t.id, t.user_id, u.name, u.phone, u.profile_image, t.trainer_type, t.approval_status
ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT tu.name AS trainerName, mu.name AS memberName, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(s.lesson_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS assignedAt, CONCAT('PT ', p.total_sessions, '회') AS membershipName, CONCAT((p.total_sessions - p.sessions_used), '회') AS remainingInfo,
CASE WHEN p.expires_at IS NULL OR p.expires_at >= NOW() THEN '이용중' ELSE '종료' END AS status
FROM PT_PACKAGE p
JOIN TRAINER t ON p.trainer_id = t.id
JOIN `USER` tu ON t.user_id = tu.id
JOIN MEMBER m ON p.client_id = m.id
JOIN `USER` mu ON m.user_id = mu.id
LEFT JOIN LESSON s ON p.id = s.package_id
WHERE t.gym_id = #{value}
GROUP BY p.id, tu.name, mu.name, p.total_sessions, p.sessions_used, p.expires_at
ORDER BY assignedAt DESC

SELECT u.name AS memberName, CONCAT('PT ', p.total_sessions, '회') AS membershipName, (p.total_sessions - p.sessions_used) AS remainingSession, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(s.lesson_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate FROM PT_PACKAGE p JOIN TRAINER t ON p.trainer_id = t.id JOIN MEMBER m ON p.client_id = m.id JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN LESSON s ON p.id = s.package_id WHERE p.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND (p.expires_at IS NULL OR p.expires_at >= NOW()) GROUP BY p.id, u.name, p.total_sessions, p.sessions_used

SELECT u.name AS memberName, CONCAT('PT ', p.total_sessions, '회') AS membershipName, (p.total_sessions - p.sessions_used) AS remainingSession, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(s.lesson_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate FROM PT_PACKAGE p JOIN TRAINER t ON p.trainer_id = t.id JOIN MEMBER m ON p.client_id = m.id JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN LESSON s ON p.id = s.package_id WHERE p.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND p.expires_at < NOW() GROUP BY p.id, u.name, p.total_sessions, p.sessions_used
